baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَحْيَاءً and أَمْوَاتًا, the coordinated accusative plurals rooted in ح ي ي and م و ت.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two unmodified plural classes form an exhaustive opposition: possession of animate life versus its loss. Coordination makes the pair a compact totality rather than two unrelated labels.

activation_trace.role: The living-creature branch supplies animate bearers of life as the first class and the positive pole of the opposition.
The loss-of-vitality branch supplies the opposed dead class and closes the binary.

changed_reading.before: A bare list of living people and dead people.
changed_reading.after: A merism spanning animate beings by the presence or loss of life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same plural pair, with ح ي ي read through preservation of life and م و ت through a realized state or occurrence of death.
baseline_models.mechanism: The roots can encode outcomes, not only fixed kinds: some remain alive while others have undergone death. The pair can therefore register a transition and its two resulting populations.

activation_trace.role: The sparing-alive branch turns living into the outcome of preserved survival.
The death-occurrence branch turns dead into the outcome or state reached by dying.

changed_reading.after: The survivor and deceased outcomes of a life-to-death process.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَحْيَاءً through the rain-revived-earth branch of ح ي ي and أَمْوَاتًا through the dead-land and lifeless-property branch of م و ت.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opposition can be material and ecological: ground may be alive through rain, fertility, and growth or dead through non-cultivation, non-use, and lifelessness.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies earth made living by rain, fertility, and vegetation as a non-biological positive pole.
The branch supplies uncultivated or unusable dead land and lifeless property as the negative pole.

changed_reading.before: Only organisms divided into living and dead.
changed_reading.after: A latent contrast between vital, productive ground and dead or unusable ground and matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding construction makes the earth into a grasping or gathering receptacle; the focus plurals then specify the opposed animate contents within its scope. The pair becomes a claim about the earth's comprehensive holding function.

activation_trace.role: Animate living beings supply one class of what the terrestrial receptacle encompasses.
Those whose vitality has gone supply the opposed class encompassed by the same receptacle.
Making something assume a condition supplies the transformation of earth into a particular functional state.
The lower realm opposed to the sky supplies the physical domain that receives both classes.
Grasping and gathering into a vessel supplies the earth's containing operation.

structural_cues: The focus ayah has no finite verb of its own and places two indefinite accusative plurals immediately after the 77:25 question.
The two focus terms are joined as parallel complements, so the prior earth-making construction can govern both together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies making, earth, vessel-like gathering, and the two classes; I supply the attachment that treats the focus plurals as the receptacle's contents. A live alternative is that they qualify the manner or range of kifāt rather than functioning as direct content labels.

changed_reading.before: Living and dead as a free-standing exhaustive pair.
changed_reading.after: The earth is made a comprehensive receptacle that gathers or holds both the living and the dead.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation from reproductive fluid proceeds through a stable, secure place for a measured term and then into the earth's gathering hold. The focus pair marks successive statuses carried through nested containers rather than merely a simultaneous census.

activation_trace.role: Animate life supplies the phase produced and carried through the sequence.
A realized state or occurrence of death supplies the later status within the same measured passage.
Bringing created life into existence supplies the opening transition.
Reproductive fluid in the womb supplies the material and first containing setting of the sequence.
Fixity and settlement supply stable holding rather than uncontrolled passage.
A place of being supplies the secure spatial enclosure paired with settlement.
A bounded measure supplies the temporal limit after which the held condition changes.
Gathering into a receptacle supplies the later terrestrial holding environment.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 forms a creation, placement, measured-term sequence before 77:25-26 returns to making and containment.
The repeated making construction at 77:21 and 77:25 aligns two different holding environments.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reproductive material, secure settlement, bounded duration, and terrestrial gathering; I infer a continuous passage from gestational holding to earthly holding. The live alternative is that the two passages are parallel demonstrations of power without a single container-to-container trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Living and dead as co-present categories.
changed_reading.after: Living and dead as measured phases carried through successive secure and terrestrial holding places.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus roots' latent living-land/dead-land opposition is placed inside an earth description and followed by supplied sweet water. Water provision becomes the material operation by which dead ground can enter a living, fertile state and sustain life.

activation_trace.role: Earth enlivened by rain and growth supplies the water-responsive positive state.
Dead, uncultivated, or unusable land supplies the reversible negative state.
Soft fertile earth supplies the material substrate in which the two vitality states can alternate.
Water itself supplies the medium required by the focus branch's rain-and-growth image.
The making of irrigation or drink supplies directed provision rather than accidental moisture.
Sweet fresh water supplies the usable quality of the life-giving medium.

structural_cues: The focus pair is enclosed by an earth statement in 77:25 and a terrain-and-water statement in 77:27.
The post-focus ayah moves from fixed mountains to supplied water, coupling stability with ongoing renewal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The focus branch itself supplies the rain-to-living-earth relation, while the packet supplies earth and water provision; I connect the contextual water to activation of that latent contrast. A live alternative is that the water sustains only the animate inhabitants named by the focus pair, without making land vitality part of their denotation.

changed_reading.before: An isolated, form-distant possibility of living versus dead land.
changed_reading.after: A hydrological earth system in which supplied fresh water sustains or restores living ground against dead ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: Revival after death, the fixed arrival of an event, judicial separation, and final gathering turn death from a terminal bin into a provisional phase. The same population can move from death into renewed assembly and differentiation.

activation_trace.role: Animate beings supply the living phase of the population that the sequence addresses.
Loss of life supplies the dead phase that later operations reopen.
Bringing the dead alive after death directly supplies reversal of the dead condition.
An event falling and becoming fixed supplies the assured transition point.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies a sorting operation after renewed presence.
Joining what was dispersed supplies the assembly of the population before separation.

structural_cues: Revival language precedes the focus, while explicit gathering and the repeated day of separation frame it at whole-surah scale.
The repeated judgment refrain prevents the earth's holding function from reading as a final resting state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies resurrection, assured occurrence, gathering, and separation; I arrange them as operations on the focus pair and infer that the dead class is temporally provisional. The live alternative is that these are parallel event images and that 77:26 remains only a static statement of terrestrial scope.

changed_reading.before: The earth permanently contains two fixed classes, living and dead.
changed_reading.after: The earth temporarily gathers a population whose dead phase will be reopened into assembly and judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Destruction of an earlier cohort, succession by a later cohort, and eventual gathering convert the living/dead opposition into a diachronic totality. The earth holds the currently living and the accumulated dead across generations until both are assembled.

activation_trace.role: Animate living beings supply the currently present cohort.
Loss of life supplies the accumulated former cohorts.
Falling into destruction supplies the transfer of an earlier living cohort into the dead class.
Beginning and precedence identify the earlier side of the generational ordering.
Succession one after another supplies the relay between cohorts.
Later after earlier supplies the second side of the generational ordering.
Joining the dispersed supplies the final collapse of generational separation into one assembly.

structural_cues: 77:16-17 explicitly pairs earlier and later populations in a destruction-and-succession sequence.
77:38 gathers the addressees with the earlier ones, extending the scope beyond one contemporaneous population.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earlier destruction, later succession, and joint gathering; I map those temporal cohorts onto the focus pair as the living present and accumulated dead. A live alternative is that the pair is only spatially exhaustive and does not itself encode generational succession.

changed_reading.before: A simultaneous inventory of living and dead inhabitants.
changed_reading.after: A cross-generational totality: present life and the dead of successive cohorts are all retained for one gathering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humility, renewed discourse, and heart-settled assent activate the focus roots as states of responsiveness. Life becomes received benefit and saving good; death becomes a heart's dull inability to understand, yield, or assent.

activation_trace.role: Life as benefit, rescue, and preserving good supplies the receptive positive condition.
Deadness of heart and lack of understanding supply the unresponsive negative condition.
Humility and self-lowering supply a bodily-social sign of responsiveness, made salient by its refusal.
Speech renewed as news or discourse supplies what a receptive heart is asked to receive.
Assent in which the heart settles supplies the positive response absent at the close.

structural_cues: The surah closes by moving from refusal of embodied submission in 77:48 to a challenge about discourse and belief in 77:50.
The repeated rejection refrain makes responsiveness, not mere exposure to speech, the closing diagnostic.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies humility, discourse, assent, beneficial life, and deadness of heart; I map these into an ethical life/death axis. The live alternative is that these closing responses characterize the people named elsewhere but do not alter the biological force of the focus pair.

changed_reading.before: Living and dead as biological conditions only.
changed_reading.after: A secondary axis of receptive, benefit-bearing life versus a deadened heart that neither yields nor assents.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reverses the ordinary negative force of dead and is not demanded by the local syntax. It remains anchored in the explicit م و ت branch of submission to truth and is cross-activated by the bowing branch of humility; downstream prose should present it only as a paradoxical lexical undertone, never as a replacement for bodily death.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَمْوَاتًا through م و ت B013, held against the beneficial-life pole available in أَحْيَاءً.

activation_trace.role: The explicit submission-to-truth branch permits dead to carry a paradoxical yielding sense.
Life as saving benefit supplies the contrastive positive pole without erasing the paradox.
Humility and self-lowering make yielding to truth contextually visible through the command that is refused.

changed_reading.before: Dead means only deprived of biological life.
changed_reading.after: Dead carries a tightly qualified paradoxical undertone of having yielded to truth, exposed by the refusal to bow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it extends death from organisms to systems whose characteristic operation has ceased. It remains anchored in the م و ت stillness-and-inactivity branch and is activated by extinguished light, removed terrain, and negated speech; downstream prose should call it a material analogy or resonance, not claim that the focus plurals directly denote stars, mountains, or speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَمْوَاتًا through م و ت B012, contrasted with the animate-operation sense of أَحْيَاءً.

activation_trace.role: Stillness and lifeless inactivity supply a functional rather than strictly biological model of death.
Animate operation supplies the active pole against functional shutdown.
Loss of light or sight supplies one image of a system's defining activity being extinguished.
Uprooting and removal supply the disabling of a formerly fixed terrestrial structure.
Speech supplies a human function whose explicit negation gives a local image of arrested operation.

changed_reading.before: Dead identifies organisms after biological death.
changed_reading.after: Dead also resonates with functional shutdown: light extinguished, structures disabled, and speakers rendered inactive.

strongest_changes: The adjacent جعل, أرض, and كفت chain turns the focus pair into the comprehensive contents of an earth-receptacle.
The creation, reproductive-water, secure-place, measured-term sequence turns living and dead into phases moving through nested holding environments.
The نشر, وقوع, فصل, and جمع sequence makes the dead class provisional: containment leads toward revival, assembly, and sorting.
Earth and supplied fresh water activate the otherwise latent opposition between living fertile ground and dead ground.
summary.what_was_special: A two-word focus with no independent verb acquired several non-collapsible mechanisms from the whole-surah packet: spatial containment, measured life-cycle passage, hydrological land vitality, generational accumulation, resurrection, and an exploratory ethical responsiveness axis.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact syntactic attachment of the two accusative plurals to كِفَاتًا remains inferential even though the adjacency is strong.
The ecological and ethical branches may be secondary resonances rather than denotational readings of the focus plurals.
The whole-surah resurrection sequence may reopen the dead class conceptually without requiring 77:26 itself to encode that temporal transition.
